inactive.short: Enable the "Polls" module in the dashboard.

noPermission.menu: You don't have permission to open the polls menu.

noPermission.close: You don't have permission to close polls in this server.

menu.title: 🗳️ Polls Menu
menu.description:
Use the buttons below to manage polls.

• **Create poll** opens a form and posts the poll in this channel.
• **Close poll** ends an active poll early.
• Voting happens on the buttons of the poll message itself.

modal.question: Question
modal.yesNoQuestionPlaceholder: e.g. Should the next event be PVP?
modal.durationPlaceholder: Leave empty for no automatic close

create.optionCount: Provide between 2 and 25 options, one per line.
create.invalidDuration: Invalid duration. Use minutes between 1 and 43200 (30 days).
create.invalidChannel: Invalid channel to post the poll.
create.saveFailed: Couldn't save the poll. Please try again.
create.postFailed: Couldn't post the poll in the channel. Check the bot's permissions.
create.endsIn: Voting ends in **{count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}**.
create.noEnd: The poll will stay open until it is closed manually.

close.noneDescription: There are no open polls to close in this server.
close.title: Close poll
close.description: Select below which poll you want to close.
close.doneDescription: The poll was closed and the message updated.
